[untitled BTM module] The dominant theme here is chromatin-based control of gene expression coupled to ubiquitin-dependent protein regulation. Polycomb components BMI1 and EED, the histone chaperone ANP32E, the chromatin remodeller SMARCA5 and the histone-binding MORF4L2 together repress or reposition nucleosomes at developmental and proliferation genes, keeping stem and progenitor identity stable and restraining tumour suppressor loci such as the CDKN2A region.

[untitled BTM module] This grouping brings together proteins that have in common little more than a shared place in interaction screens, yet several of them converge on mitotic and genome-maintenance functions. SSNA1 is a microtubule-associated protein that promotes filament branching and localises to centrosomes and the midbody, and RASSF7 is likewise a centrosomal Ras-association domain protein required for orderly spindle formation and mitotic entry.

[untitled BTM module] This grouping centres on control of cell survival and proliferation decisions during tissue growth and differentiation. Two hubs stand out: the retinoblastoma protein RB1, which restrains the G1/S transition by holding E2F-dependent transcription in check and whose loss underlies retinoblastoma and many sporadic cancers, and BCL2L1, an anti-apoptotic member of the BCL2 family that guards mitochondrial outer membrane integrity and blocks cytochrome c release.

[untitled BTM module] This grouping centres on the housekeeping machinery that keeps mitochondria energetically competent while proteins and metabolites are turned over. Two accessory subunits of respiratory complex I sit alongside the mitochondrial translation elongation factor TUFM, which delivers aminoacyl-tRNAs to the mitoribosome and so supplies the organelle-encoded core of the respiratory chain; PRELID1 participates in phospholipid transfer between mitochondrial membranes, and TMEM160 is an inner-membrane protein.

members: [untitled BTM module] The dominant theme here is transmembrane solute handling in polarized epithelia of liver and kidney, coupled to regulated vesicular secretion. Several members are plasma-membrane carriers that set how nutrients and ions cross epithelial barriers: GLUT2 moves glucose across hepatocyte and beta-cell membranes and underlies glucose sensing, the organic cation transporter SLC22A2 clears cationic drugs and metabolites in the proximal tubule, SLC6A13 imports betaine and GABA, and the copper-transporting ATPase ATP7B loads copper onto ceruloplasmin and excretes excess into bile, its loss causing Wnson disease.

only_in_confusable: [untitled BTM module] This grouping describes the transcriptional programme of immature myeloid progenitors in the bone marrow, the stage at which granulocyte, mast cell and erythroid potential is still being resolved and primary granule proteins are first made. Its hallmark products are the azurophilic granule enzymes myeloperoxidase and neutrophil elastase, together with the mast cell protease carboxypeptidase A3 and the promyelocyte membrane marker MS4A3, so the signature marks promyelocytes and their close relatives rather than mature blood cells.
